<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="upgrade-order-necromancy" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Upgrade Order - Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction-disclaimer"><ins><nowiki>Introduction &amp; Disclaimer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 23rd October 2026</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The order is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>subject to change at any time</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Please note the following assumptions:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Priorities may be different</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if you are doing niche content</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ &quot;ROI&quot; (meaning return-on-investment) typically means </nowiki><strong><nowiki>quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not recommend selling an item to buy another</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, unless it is a direct upgrade</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Unlisted items</nowiki></strong><nowiki> are not worth buying</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Feel free to ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> for a tailored list to the content that you do!</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="necromancy-upgrade-order"><ins><nowiki>Necromancy Upgrade Order</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>For further information on each upgrade, check </nowiki><span><nowiki>#armour-and-weapons</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perk-information</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#permanent-unlocks</nowiki></span><nowiki>, or </nowiki><span><nowiki>#eof-specs</nowiki></span></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="kilis-tasks"><nowiki>Kili's Tasks</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Upon reaching level 70 you have the option to choose your path between power and tank armour. Completing either branch allows you to also create the same tier weaponry.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Death</nowiki><strong><nowiki>dealer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783479810117702.png?v=1" alt="dealerhood80" title="dealerhood80" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - experienced players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Death</nowiki><strong><nowiki>warden</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142782592878387321.png?v=1" alt="wardenhood80" title="wardenhood80" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - less experienced players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: these tasks are generally easier, but slightly more time consuming</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ T70 Deathwarden (Tank Armour)</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Conjurer's Raising Amulet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1254471154362744862.png?v=1" alt="conjurersamulet" title="conjurersamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 107,360</nowiki></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upgrade to T80 Weapons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809249061929082.png?v=1" alt="deathguard80" title="deathguard80" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809247308709988.png?v=1" alt="skulllantern80" title="skulllantern80" kind="icon" /></p>
